question: Total order amount per city
reference_sql: SELECT c.city, SUM(o.amount) FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.city

question: What is the name of the customer who spent the most in total?
reference_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id ORDER BY SUM(o.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: List the ids of orders with an amount above 500
reference_sql: SELECT id FROM orders WHERE amount > 500

question: What is the average order amount?
Names of customers who placed an order in November 2026
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_date LIKE '2026-11%'
